name: Arch Erimos
source: Sumi's form when she is transformed by the power of the light armor, Alexandros. She uses her great sword, Gordion Schneiter, to cut down any foes. Due to her outstanding offensive power, she engages in a battle as a vanguard. Her finishing move is Erimos Nero, a technique which she imbues her sword with magic to unleash a wide-area wave of attack.
